name: AI for Chemistry Club
description: A student-run community exploring AI, chemistry and the wider world of science.
about: We start with the meeting of AI and chemistry, and follow the questions further: into mathematics, physics and AI itself. Through workshops, shared learning and collaborative practice, we aim to help students build useful skills and explore ideas together.

affiliation.text: A student-run Department-associated Group supported by the Department of Chemistry at The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology.

focusAreas.title: AI × Chemistry
focusAreas.description: Our starting point: learning how AI can help us ask and investigate chemical questions.

focusAreas.title: AI for Science
focusAreas.description: Ideas across mathematics, physics and other sciences, with room to learn from each other.

focusAreas.title: AI & practical tools
focusAreas.description: Foundations, methods and everyday skills, from understanding AI to collaborating with Git and GitHub.

activities.title: Getting started with AI & GitHub
activities.summary: An introductory workshop is being planned around AI fundamentals and Git/GitHub. Further details will be shared once confirmed.
